protocol.split: Author validation 50 and test 50, aligned by stripped Medical Record ID to Results/*_data_result.txt. Validation BOM is stripped. Train 200 retained only for overlap audit. Source schemas and part of test answer file were inspected to establish format; no test model scores used for design or selection.
protocol.correction: Earlier reports incorrectly said official validation/test answers were unavailable. They are separately published in Results, and the author's evaluate.py treats them as standard answers. Earlier numerical results remain unchanged; their data-availability interpretation is superseded.
protocol.design: Same simplified prompt and chunk boundaries for all three variants. Extract text and present only; canonical mapping is deterministic and separate. schema constrains required JSON fields/types; source_schema additionally limits text to contiguous source substrings up to 32 chars, without dictionary or gold. No retries, no bracket completion. Reject malformed, ungrounded and out-of-schema items; keep all 50 cases in denominators.
protocol.selection: Maximum validation exact-surface micro-F1 against expert Clinical Information, including both asserted and negated extracted findings because the reference contains clinically relevant negative findings. Stable variant order for ties. Save validation metrics and selected variant before running test. Publish all three test variants; do not reselect from test.
baselines: active SymMap symptom names, literal matching
v3 strict original prompt on official test only
metrics: Strict expert surface-term micro precision/recall/F1 and exact-set rate
Author Task1 exact-term recall averaged by case
Character-position overlap F1 on only verbatim-locatable expert terms, with reference coverage and copy-all baseline
JSON and schema validity, grounded quote rate, truncations, latency
24-concept dictionary-projected interface agreement as secondary biased metric only
limits: General TCM, not the original diabetes cohort
Expert terms can paraphrase the source; grounded strict-term recall has a measurable ceiling
Substring constraints guarantee quoting, not medical correctness
The 24-concept reference projection favors the rule system and is not the primary score
No automatic promotion to clinical workflow

model_manifest.verification: Full file SHA256 must match the immutable Hugging Face revision, including when using the author's ModelScope mirror
